description:
Join us live for four hours of GitHub Copilot, from the people building it and the developers putting it to work. 

⏰ Schedule in PDT
8:00 AM - Welcome to GitHub Copilot Day with Kyle Daigle
8:05 AM - Dream it, build it, ship it with James Montemagno
8:30 AM - Agent Skills with Matt Pocock
8:50 AM - Inside Project HydraFusion: Multi-Model Orchestration with Aashna Garg  & Julia Kasper
9:15 AM - Copilot everywhere with Meagan Cojocar
9:30 AM - Claude, Codex, and BYOK in GitHub Copilot for VS Code with Tyler Leonhardt
9:40 AM - One Session, Every Surface: Inside Copilot’s Agent Runtime and SDK with Patrick Nikoletich
10:00 AM - Live Coding with Wes Bos, Burke Holland, Pierce Boggan & Friends

September 10, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Pacific. 

#GitHubCopilot #CopilotDay #GitHub

Stay up-to-date on all things GitHub by subscribing and following us at: 

YouTube: http://bit.ly/subgithub 
Blog: https://github.blog 
X: https://twitter.com/github 
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/github 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/github 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@github 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/GitHub/ 

About GitHub: 

It’s where over 180 million developers create, share, and ship the best code possible. It’s a place for anyone, from anywhere, to build anything—it’s where the world builds software. https://github.com
